---
title: "run_cox_models"
author: "Jesús F García Gavilán"
date: "2026-01-13"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
run_cox_models = function(data, approaches, reales = approaches, models,
                           time_var = "follcox_19", event_var = "death19",
                           digits = 3, export_path = NULL,
                           robust = F, weights = NULL) {
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ARGUMENTOS:
  # data: Base de datos que contiene time_var, event_var y covariables (ej. Scores_mort_bas).
  # approaches: Vector de caracteres con los nombres de las variables de exposición (ej. "CQI_pre").
  # reales: Vector de etiquetas para la tabla de salida (ej. "CQI Score"). Mismo orden que 'approaches'.
  # models: Lista de listas definiendo los ajustes. Estructura: list("Modelo 1" = list(covariates = "+ edad...")).
  # time_var: Nombre de la columna de tiempo de seguimiento (ej. "follcox_19").
  # event_var: Nombre de la columna de evento (ej. "death19").
  # digits: Decimales para redondeo de HR e IC (default = 3).
  # export_path: (Opcional) Ruta completa del archivo .xlsx a exportar. Si es NULL, no exporta.
  # robust: (Logical) Si es TRUE, calcula errores estándar robustos.
  # weights: (Opcional) Nombre de la columna de pesos o vector numérico.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  stopifnot(length(approaches) == length(reales))
  stopifnot(is.list(models))

  if (!requireNamespace("survival", quietly = T)) {
    stop("Necesitas instalar 'survival'")
  }

  surv_lhs = paste0("survival::Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ")

  fmt_p = function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
    p_round = round(p, digits)
    if (!is.na(p_round) && p_round == 0) return(paste0("<", format(10^-digits, scientific = F)))
    as.character(p_round)
  }

  # Detecta tipo: continua vs ntile
  detect_type = function(x) {
    if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x) || is.ordered(x)) return("ntile")
    if (is.numeric(x) && length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 6) return("ntile")
    "continua"
  }

  extract_term = function(fit_obj, term, var_type, real_name) {
    s = summary(fit_obj)
    rn = rownames(s$coefficients)

    if (var_type == "continua") {
      idx = match(term, rn)
      if (is.na(idx)) {
        return(data.frame(approach = term, label = real_name, type = var_type,
                          level = NA_character_, HR = NA, lower_95 = NA,
                          upper_95 = NA, P_value = NA_character_,
                          stringsAsFactors = F))
      }

      hr = s$conf.int[idx, c("exp(coef)", "lower .95", "upper .95")]
      p  = s$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]

      return(data.frame(approach = term, label = real_name, type = var_type,
                        level = NA_character_,
                        HR = round(hr[1], digits),
                        lower_95 = round(hr[2], digits),
                        upper_95 = round(hr[3], digits),
                        P_value = fmt_p(p),
                        stringsAsFactors = F))
    }

    idxs = grep(paste0("^", term), rn)

    if (length(idxs) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(approach = term, label = real_name, type = var_type,
                        level = NA_character_, HR = NA, lower_95 = NA,
                        upper_95 = NA, P_value = NA_character_,
                        stringsAsFactors = F))
    }

    out = lapply(idxs, function(j) {
      hr = s$conf.int[j, c("exp(coef)", "lower .95", "upper .95")]
      p  = s$coefficients[j, "Pr(>|z|)"]

      data.frame(approach = term, label = real_name, type = var_type, level = rn[j],
                 HR = round(hr[1], digits),
                 lower_95 = round(hr[2], digits),
                 upper_95 = round(hr[3], digits),
                 P_value = fmt_p(p),
                 stringsAsFactors = F)
    })

    do.call(rbind, out)
  }

  wts = NULL
  if (!is.null(weights)) {
    if (is.character(weights) && length(weights) == 1) {
      if (!weights %in% names(data)) stop("La columna indicada en 'weights' no existe en 'data'.")
      wts = data[[weights]]
    } else {
      if (length(weights) != nrow(data)) stop("'weights' debe tener longitud nrow(data) o ser el nombre de una columna.")
      wts = weights
    }
  }

  # Salidas
  fits = list()
  results = list()

  # Guardar tipo por approach (informativo)
  var_type = setNames(vapply(approaches, function(a) detect_type(data[[a]]), character(1)), approaches)

  for (m in names(models)) {
    results[[m]] = vector("list", length(approaches))
    names(results[[m]]) = reales
    fits[[m]] = vector("list", length(approaches))
  }

  # Loop principal
  for (i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    a = approaches[i]
    a_type = var_type[[a]]
    real_name = reales[i]

    for (m in names(models)) {
      spec = models[[m]]

      rhs = if (!is.null(spec$interaction)) {
        paste0(a, " * ", spec$interaction,
               if (!is.null(spec$covariates)) paste0(" + ", spec$covariates) else "")
      } else {
        paste0(a, if (!is.null(spec$covariates)) paste0(spec$covariates) else "")
      }

      f = as.formula(paste0(surv_lhs, rhs))

      fit = survival::coxph(f, data = data, robust = robust, weights = wts)

      fits[[m]][[i]] = fit
      results[[m]][[i]] = extract_term(fit, a, a_type, real_name)
    }
  }

  full_table = do.call(rbind, unlist(lapply(names(results), function(m) {
    block = do.call(rbind, results[[m]])
    sep = data.frame(approach = NA_character_, label = m, type = NA_character_,
                     level = NA_character_, HR = NA, lower_95 = NA,
                     upper_95 = NA, P_value = NA_character_,
                     stringsAsFactors = F)
    list(sep, block)
  }), recursive = F))

  modelos = as.data.frame(full_table, stringsAsFactors = F)

  if (!is.null(export_path)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("rio", quietly = T)) {
      stop("Instala 'rio' para exportar")
    }
    rio::export(modelos, export_path)
  }

  invisible(list(fits = fits, results = results, full_table = modelos))
}

```
